brief:
WAVE-1 AS BUILT (use these names, not the design sketch): `PlaybackBackend` protocol = iosApp/iosApp/Screens/Player/ControlPlane/PlaybackBackend.swift (nonisolated protocol, AVPlayerBackend conforms via an extension at the end of AVPlayerBackend.swift; 17 callback closures + 3 providers are `{ get set }` requirements; `FakePlaybackBackend` in iosApp/Tests). `RecoveryPolicy.decide(_ observation: RecoveryObservation, context: RecoveryContext, now: Date) -> (action: RecoveryAction?, context: RecoveryContext)` in Screens/Player/Recovery/ (observations: startupTick(servedRequests:displayModeSwitchInProgress:), playheadTick(PlayheadSample), itemDeathEvidence(statusCode:description:weight:position:userPaused:), edgeSample(EdgeSample), playbackStalled, itemFailedToEnd(position:userPaused:), playlistUnchanged(userPaused:), likelyToKeepUp(rate:bufferedAhead:reachedEnd:likely:), seekDeadlineExpired(kind: SeekDeadlineKind), engineFailed(PlaybackFailure), originOutage(active:), sourceInterrupted(reason: PlaybackSourceInterruptionReason), sessionMissing(source: SessionMissingSource), serverHealthProbe(ok:), bufferingChanged(Bool); actions per RecoveryAction.swift: reassertPlay, nudgeStartup, reloadStartupItem, reanchor(atMediaSeconds:reason:), reloadItem(atMediaSeconds:reason:), restartProducer(atSegmentIndex:authoritative:), rebuildLocalSession(atMediaSeconds:reason:), deferUntilPlay(mediaSeconds:), resumePlayback, treatAsNaturalEnd, requestServerReplan(classification:message:), switchRoute(RouteFallback), renewSourceInBackground(reason:), renewSessionFresh(reason:), rideThroughOutage(probeAfter:), endOutageRideThrough(kick:), recoverFromServerOutage(reason:), waitForServerReady(probeAfter:), autoRecoverInterruption, fail(PlaybackFailure); `RecoveryContext` fields: route, playbackEstablished, userPaused, suspendedReasons, mediaTimelineOffset, startup?, playhead, itemDeath, itemDeathConfirmation, edge?, rebuildBudget, outage?, serverOutageRecovery?, backgroundRenewalTransientFailures, backgroundRenewalInFlight, freshRenewalInFlight, canRenewSourceInBackground, isProtocolV3Active, isReplanInFlight, hasWatchDetail, canAutoRecoverInterruption, attemptedNativeDirectFallback, attemptedLoopbackHLSFallback, canBuildLoopbackFallback, nearEnd?; `RecoveryContext.initial(route:)`; NOTE its `==` is reflection-based: never compare contexts on a hot path). `TrackSelectionCoordinator` (Screens/Player/Tracks/, NOT @MainActor) with `TrackSelectionPorts` whose `backend: () -> AVPlayerBackend?` must keep returning the live concrete backend; `PlaybackSessionBridge.init(transport:)`, `currentSessionId`, `stopSession(expectedSessionId:position:isPaused:)`; wave-1E control-plane types (LoadID, SessionIdentity, ExecutablePlan, PlaybackState family incl. EngineEvent/SessionEvent/TransportEvent/Effect) in Screens/Player/ControlPlane/ -- read their 'As built (wave 1E)' block in design section 2.3 before using them. Reviewer obligations carried from wave 1B for whoever wires the policy: (a) the startup ladder's stage lives in `context.startup` (non-nil while arming): do NOT clear it when the startup timer is cancelled if the `-15628` direct escalation (B:3499 at 20ba06b) can still fire before the file-loaded edge; (b) the policy's `waitForServerReady` issues one probe exactly at the 90 s boundary that legacy did not -- acceptable, documented in design section 7; (c) at outage entry, if the player is already buffering, emit `.bufferingChanged(true)` right after `.originOutage(active: true)` so the 'Reconnecting' notice logic (PVM:4290-4294 at 20ba06b) still fires.

WAVE 2b -- ONE package (effort max): every recovery DECISION moves to RecoveryPolicy via a RecoveryDriver; AVPlayerBackend emits RecoveryObservations and executes RecoveryActions; PlaybackEngineSession (one per LoadID) owns backend + source proxy + LocalHLSHost and exposes ONE event stream; PlayerViewModel still orchestrates loads (wave 3 does the reducer/actor cutover) but talks only to PlaybackEngineSession + RecoveryDriver.

STEP 1 (observations out, perform in). In AVPlayerBackend replace each ladder's DECISION code with emission through `var onRecoveryObservation: ((RecoveryObservation) -> Void)?`: `.startupTick(servedRequests:displayModeSwitchInProgress:)` from the 1 Hz startup timer (keep the timer and its arm/cancel semantics; the -15628 direct entry at B:3499 emits its observation per wave-1B obligation (a)); `.playheadTick(PlayheadSample(...))` from the 1 Hz playhead timer with exactly the fields the policy needs (position, timeControl, bufferedAhead, generatedAhead, secondsSinceLastServe, userPaused, playbackEstablished, pendingSeekMediaTarget...) -- keep the telemetry log lines in the tick; `.itemDeathEvidence` from errorLog/failedToEnd (weights as today), `.itemFailedToEnd` for the established-item failedToEnd (B:3453-3461), `.edgeSample` from the time observer + generated stats, `.playbackStalled`, `.playlistUnchanged(userPaused:)`, `.likelyToKeepUp(...)` from the two KVOs, `.seekDeadlineExpired(kind:)`. Add `func perform(_ action: RecoveryAction)` executing the legacy bodies: reassertPlay -> avPlayer.play(); nudgeStartup -> nudgeLoopbackStartupConsumer; reloadStartupItem -> reloadLoopbackStartupItem; reanchor -> flushOnSeek + extractor seek + load(.siloLoopback(spec.reanchored(at:))) (for a VOD stall this includes `host.requestProducerRestart(authoritative: true)` first, exactly as performVODStallRecovery B:1917 does -- document it); reloadItem -> reloadEstablishedLoopbackItem; restartProducer -> host.requestProducerRestart; rebuildLocalSession -> load(reanchored) (the budget lives in the policy context now); deferUntilPlay -> a stored deferredRecoveryMediaTime consumed by play() (today's pendingLocalLoopbackRecoveryMediaTime semantics); resumePlayback -> avPlayer.play(); fail -> reportFailure. DELETE: the ladders' decision code, watchdogReanchorCount/WindowStartWall, didEscalateLoopbackStall, lastLocalLoopbackStallRecoveryAt, loopbackItemDeathRecoveryState/ConfirmationState fields (types stay -- the policy context owns instances), loopbackEdgeWatch, the loopbackRebuildBudget field, setRecoverySuspended/setExternalStallSuppression/kickPlaybackAfterExternalStallCleared (suspension = RecoveryContext.suspendedReasons set by the driver; the kick = `.endOutageRideThrough(kick:)` performed as the old kick body under the same guards). Remove those three from the PlaybackBackend protocol and from FakePlaybackBackend.
STEP 2 (RecoveryDriver). iosApp/iosApp/Screens/Player/Recovery/RecoveryDriver.swift -- `@MainActor final class RecoveryDriver { private(set) var context: RecoveryContext; init(route:); func observe(_ o: RecoveryObservation, now: Date = Date()) -> RecoveryAction?; func setSuspended(_ on: Bool, reason: String); func note(userPaused:) / note(playbackEstablished:) / note(mediaTimelineOffset:) / note(isProtocolV3Active:...) }` -- the only place `RecoveryPolicy.decide` is called at runtime. One per PlaybackEngineSession (so per LoadID).
STEP 3 (PlaybackEngineSession). iosApp/iosApp/Screens/Player/Engine/PlaybackEngineSession.swift per design section 2.8: `@MainActor final class PlaybackEngineSession { let loadID: LoadID; let plan: ExecutablePlan; private(set) var backend: any PlaybackBackend; var surfaceBackend: AVPlayerBackend?; private(set) var transport: PlaybackSourceProxy?; let driver: RecoveryDriver; let events: AsyncStream<EngineEvent>; init(loadID:plan:backendFactory:reusing existing: PlaybackEngineSession?, sourceCacheHandoff:); func start(startSeconds:) throws; func perform(_ action: RecoveryAction) async; func seek(_ r: SeekRequest); func retargetSource(url:headers:); func dispose(reason:) }`. `reusing` non-nil => adopt the existing backend instance (tvOS in-place replan, I4) and re-bind its closures to this session's stream. The 17 backend callbacks are translated into EngineEvent cases (use the 1E EngineEvent as built; add cases only if a callback has no counterpart and record it in the design section 2.3 as-built block); the backend's `onRecoveryObservation` -> `driver.observe` -> loopback in-route actions performed immediately by `backend.perform`; VM-level actions (treatAsNaturalEnd, requestServerReplan, renew*, rideThroughOutage/endOutageRideThrough, recoverFromServerOutage/waitForServerReady, autoRecoverInterruption, switchRoute, fail) are emitted as `EngineEvent.recoveryAction(RecoveryAction)` on the same stream. Move prepareSourceProxy/stash/discard/adopt cache handoff (PVM:2907-3070 at 20ba06b -- re-grep, PlayerViewModel is now 6,415 lines) into the engine session; proxy callbacks (onPlaybackSessionMissing / onPlaybackSourceInterrupted / onOriginOutageChanged) become `.sessionMissing(.proxy404)` / `.sourceInterrupted(reason:)` / `.originOutage(active:)` observations into the driver (+ the wave-1B obligation (c) `.bufferingChanged(true)` re-emission at outage entry if already buffering).
STEP 4 (VM retarget). PlayerViewModel: `avPlayerBackend` becomes `engineSession?.surfaceBackend` (views unchanged; TrackSelectionPorts.backend keeps returning it); loadStream builds/reuses a PlaybackEngineSession and consumes `events` in ONE registered task per LoadID (delete makeCallbacks/applyCallbacks/wireSubtitleCallbacks and their by-value generation guards -- the stream ends when the session is disposed; keep `streamLoadGeneration` ONLY if a non-callback site still needs it and say which); installBackend/prepareBackend/loadBackend/reapplyUserGain fold into the session; handlePlaybackError's ladder -> `driver.observe(.engineFailed(f))` and the returned action; the VM's recovery functions keep their EXECUTION bodies but lose their DECISION preambles (rung order, hasAttempted* latches (-> context flags), thresholds); handleOriginOutageChanged/noteBufferingDuringSourceOutage/clearSourceOutageRideThroughState decisions -> policy (the ride-through poll loop stays as the executor of `.rideThroughOutage`/`.waitForServerReady` and feeds `.serverHealthProbe(ok:)` back into the driver).
STEP 5 (tests). PlaybackEngineSessionTests (FakePlaybackBackend: start/dispose/reuse keeps the instance; event translation; perform maps actions -> calls; observation -> driver -> action), RecoveryDriverTests (suspension -> nil; context threading; the -15628 startup obligation), extend LocalHLSHostTests if the host surface changed. Full suite on a cloned sim + same-host control. Build all three schemes.
STEP 6 (greps, 0 hits in iosApp/iosApp): `setExternalStallSuppression`, `kickPlaybackAfterExternalStallCleared`, `setRecoverySuspended(`, `watchdogReanchorCount`, `didEscalateLoopbackStall`, `makeCallbacks(`, `applyCallbacks(`, `hasAttemptedNativeDirectRouteRecovery`, `hasAttemptedSiloRouteHLSFallback`.
